name: A static caller is refused a runtime-added member

input.fixture_ref: fixture: {setup: "programmatic open adds public extra() to A", actions: ["static caller uses A", "reflective caller invokes extra"]}

applicability.reason: Requires static receiver typing. Re-probed, and the earlier reason was half wrong: it reported the reflective path erroring, but that measurement used `m.call(receiver)`, which is not the surface. C118 fixes it as `Reflection::Class.invoke(method, receiver, args)`, and measured that way the reflective half ALREADY holds - a member added by a programmatic open is fetched with `Reflection::Class.method` and invoked successfully after publication, which is exactly what this row permits. What remains is the static half: rejecting `A.new().extra()` at a STATIC call site requires inferring that `A.new()` has static Type A and checking A's declared spine, and the analyser tracks no expression Types. That is the same missing subsystem CONTROL-V937 and TYPES-V920 name, so this row belongs with them rather than with ordinary reflection surfaces.

expect.status: Static call is rejected; reflective/Dynamic call is permitted only after successful publication.
